t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : Blessed be he who humbles himself, whose livelihood is pure, whose heart is chaste, whose habits are virtuous, who spends his savings " in the name of Allah ", who prevents his tongue from speaking nonsense, who keeps people safe from evil, who is pleased with the (Prophet's) sunnah, and who is unconnected with innovation (in religion). Al-Sayyid al-Radi says : Some people attribute this and the previous saying to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his descendants)
